_comment: EXAMPLE FILE. Copy to company_context.json and replace with your own company's details. This file is injected into every agent run, so it shapes every brief, battlecard, and recommendation. The values below describe a fictional company (Northwind Analytics) purely to show the shape.
tagline: Product analytics for teams that ship fast
key_differentiators: Warehouse-native - runs on the customer's own data warehouse, no data duplication
Self-serve setup in under an hour, no implementation services required
Transparent usage-based pricing with a generous free tier
Deep product-led-growth workflows out of the box
known_weaknesses: Smaller template and integration library than the incumbent
Less brand recognition with enterprise buyers

Competitor A: A large partner and integration marketplace
Competitor B: New AI 'ask your data' natural-language query assistant
Session replay bundled into the core plan

win_themes: Warehouse-native means no data leaves the customer's control
Time-to-value in hours, not a six-week implementation
Pricing that scales with value, not seats
loss_themes: Competitor A wins on enterprise governance and procurement comfort
Competitor B wins on breadth of features in a single bundle

icp.primary: Product and growth teams at 50-1,000 person B2B SaaS companies with a modern data warehouse
icp.buyer: Head of Product, Head of Growth, or a product-led-growth lead
